evidence.why: Selecting a catalog filter moves focus off the search input and drops the next character.
Same focus-loss behavior, same component, and the ticket already carries a Duplicate link to RHDHBUGS-1009.

sameFailure.summary: Both reports lose search focus and drop the next keystroke.

sameTrigger.summary: Both reproduce when selecting a catalog-table filter, not during a different navigation action.

sameFix.summary: Restoring search-input focus after the filter update addresses both reports; no separate failure is described.

canonical.summary: Retain the earlier June report as the implementation tracker rather than the redundant July report.

comment: Closing as a duplicate of [RHDHBUGS-1009](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/RHDHBUGS-1009). The focus-loss behavior and component match, and the existing Duplicate link points at the same defect.
